scope: Authored source qualification for bounded blocking ADC scans. No copied vendor implementation/tables, no driver changes, tests, mocks, hardware execution, or RF qualification.

other_hardware_capabilities.semantics: MODE=4 executes selected slots once in slot order. EOC marks each result, RESULTy stores slot y, EOS marks all slots done, and START clears automatically. START=0 is documented to stop conversion; the inspected classic sections do not state the explicit cursor-reset guarantee of L010/L011.
other_hardware_capabilities.status: Hardware capability qualified; separate classic implementation work remains. Do not treat these as unsupported hardware or inherit L010/L011 layout.

other_hardware_capabilities.semantics: ADC1 and ADC2 each have eight independently programmed slots and result registers; CONT=0 completes all slots then asserts EOS and clears START. START=0 stops conversion and resets slot position.

differences.shared_resources: Common BGR/temperature control and ADC clock; synchronized sibling ownership must be handled.

other_hardware_capabilities.status: Implemented independently in adc/l012.rs; current contract and proof in docs/adc-l012-scans.md. No L010/L011 layout alias.

limits: Source qualification is not silicon validation.
Classic and L012 hardware scan capability does not authorize metadata promotion through the L010/L011 driver.
Repeated source sampling is a permitted register use; source settling and pin ownership still apply.

semantics.ordering: Slots execute in ascending slot index; each slot independently selects a mux source. Results retain slot order rather than source-number order.
semantics.repeat_mux_evidence: Own manual §20.5 and §20.12.4 independently permit every slot to select any source, without a uniqueness restriction. Repeated mux support follows that register contract; no same-source L010 example was found in the inspected ADC examples.
semantics.completion: Each conversion writes its RESULTy and sets EOC. EOS marks completion of all selected slots, including the last result; single-scan mode automatically clears START and stops. Require EOS and START=0 before copying a completed scan; retaining an EOC check is conservative.
semantics.flags: ISR status fields and RESULT fields are read-only, not read-to-clear in the documented register model; software clears EOC/EOS with ICR write zero. Do not infer that reading RESULT acknowledges EOS.
semantics.abort: Writing START=0 stops conversion and resets sequence position. The next START begins at slot zero. A timeout or cancellation must not report partial results as a complete scan.
semantics.sampling: Sample time is independent per slot, but CLK is common. Every slot must meet acquisition/rate limits at one chosen divider. TS and BGR each require at least 40 microseconds acquisition; startup/settling applies before starting the scan.
semantics.shared_resources: BGREN is shared with other analog users; preserve inherited BGR enable and clock ownership. This is software ownership policy supported by existing driver, not a new register capability.

semantics.ordering: CONT=0 executes SQRCH0 through SQRCH[ENS] once. Each slot selects its own source and sampling cycles, and RESULTy corresponds to slot y.
semantics.repeat_mux_evidence: Own sections25.5 and25.12.4 independently permit every slot to select any source, with no uniqueness condition. Repetition follows this register contract; inspected L012 SDK examples do not independently demonstrate a repeated-source scan.
semantics.completion: Require EOC, EOS and START=0 before copying any result. ISR/RESULT are RO, not read-to-clear. ICR clears defined flags by writing0.
semantics.abort: START=0 stops conversion and resets slot cursor. Timeout then disables this converter and its interrupt/trigger/watchdog controls; it neither accesses sibling writes nor changes the shared clock/reset/BGR/TS.
semantics.sibling: Both converter instances share Common owning BGR. Constructors/reconfiguration/conversions reject sibling SLAVE before ADC changes, including a disabled sibling. Owned local SLAVE is configured0; raw users must not race sibling SLAVE changes. Independent sibling conversions remain permitted.
semantics.timing: Each slot independently validates acquisition and conversion rate at maximum ClockBounds, minimum ADC4MHz at minimum bounds. One maximum selected divider meets all constraints. TS/BGR >=40us acquisition; shared enables are monotonic; wait50us at maximum HCLK for any internal scan. Startup covers max(50us,15 ADC cycles).
semantics.limitations: No synchronous/dual-coupled, continuous, externally triggered, IRQ/DMA scan, DAC-source, calibrated-unit or averaged-result API. Raw counts only.
